`db.execute('CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS notes (text TEXT)')` — Runs an expression; print displays a value and calls may have side effects—without the line, that action does not occur.

questions.prompt:
What exact output does code example 2 in this lesson produce?

import sqlite3
connection = sqlite3.connect(':memory:')
connection.execute('CREATE TABLE scores (name TEXT, value INTEGER)')
connection.execute('INSERT INTO scores VALUES (?, ?)', ('Ada', 10))
print(connection.execute('SELECT name, value FROM scores').fetchone())
connection.close()
